enrollKey(bytes32,bytes32,bool).details: Called through a user operation signed by an already-registered signer, so a new      device can only be added by a device the owner already controls (spec §1.5      `DeviceEnroll`). Onboarding enrols the first key via `onInstall`.

isValidSignatureForAccount(address,bytes.details: Public so the Agent can dry-run a signature before spending a user operation.

onInstall(bytes).details: `data = abi.encodePacked(x, y, requireOsConfirm)` (65 bytes) — the first device key.

onUninstall(bytes).details: Clears every key for the calling account.

revokeKey(bytes32).details: The last remaining key cannot be removed: that would lock the owner out of their own      account. Recovery of a sole lost device is Z-2.A.1 (social recovery).

validateUserOp((address,uint256,bytes,by.details: Validation is view-only; no state is written, so the bundler's ERC-7562 rules are met.
